run_metadata.coverage_summary: Tier 1 Commonwealth (AusTender) covered via search-indexed detail; NSW (buy.nsw / NSW eTendering), Victoria (Buying for Victoria), Queensland (QTenders / VendorPanel), WA (Tenders WA), Tasmania (Tenders Tas / Dept of State Growth) landing and search-indexed listings reviewed. Tier 2 sampled (CSIRO, universities incl. ANU/USyd, water GBEs, VendorPanel councils). Tier 3 attempted (SAP Ariba Discovery + major-buyer portals incl. Transgrid, NBN Co) — no publicly-visible corporate RFx was readable; corporate channels recorded in discovered_sources only. MAJOR LIMITATION THIS RUN (unchanged from recent runs): direct WebFetch to essentially every Australian government, council, water-corporation, university-portal and e-sourcing domain returned HTTP 403 from the destination site's bot/WAF protection (the egress proxy itself reported healthy). All tender detail below was therefore reconstructed from search-engine indexed snippets rather than the primary notices, so some fields could not be verified to primary-source fidelity and are left null. Prioritised opportunities open or recently published/updated. Several ATM IDs that surfaced in search (RFT-2026-0080 Federal Court, MSD/RFT/55619/1 Defence, ATM_2026_6026 DCCEEW) were verified as already CLOSED and excluded; the CSIRO Parkes Observatory EOI captured on 2026-07-30 has since closed and was not re-recorded as open. No tenders, dates, deliverables or contacts were fabricated.
gaps: WebFetch blocked (HTTP 403 from destination WAF, not the proxy) on EVERY primary source attempted this run: tenders.gov.au (/atm index + /Atm/Show detail pages), tenders.nsw.gov.au / buy.nsw (RFT.show detail + opportunity/search), vendorpanel.com.au/PublicTenders.aspx, innerwest.nsw.gov.au current-tenders, and illion.tenderlink.com listing pages. All tender detail below was taken from search-indexed summaries, not primary notice pages.

SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery: public posting board not readable (login/JS-gated + 403 on direct fetch). No Australian corporate RFx captured as a tender this run; portal recorded in discovered_sources only, per registration-gated policy.

Tier 3 major-buyer portals (Transgrid ibuy, NBN Co, Australia Post, BHP, Rio Tinto, Woolworths, Coles, Qantas, CBA/Westpac/NAB/ANZ, Telstra/Optus, AGL/Origin): supplier opportunities are registration- or invitation-gated on SAP Ariba/Coupa; no publicly-visible open RFx surfaced this run. Confirmed Transgrid and NBN Co both run procurement via SAP Ariba — recorded as sources.
EstimateOne, iTWOcx, BidContender (construction subcontractor packages): live package listings require a supplier login; not readable this run. No subcontractor packages captured.

CSIRORFT2026004 (grid-fed electricity supply to CSIRO WA sites): closing date not extractable from search-indexed snippet (AusTender detail page 403). Captured at headline level; flagged in entries_pending_detail.

Tasmania Northern Suburbs Community Recreation Hub Stage 3: search snippets disagreed on the closing date (a GovMarket snippet showed '17 Jul 2026' which is inconsistent with a 22-Jul-2026 tender release). Closing date left null pending verification on Tenders Tasmania; project scope/value ($18.9M) corroborated across multiple public sources.

Victoria, Queensland, WA, SA, NT, ACT core state portals: only landing/index pages were reachable via search; no jurisdiction-specific NEW tender detail could be confirmed to primary-source fidelity this run (403 on all detail pages). Deferred to a future run when portal fetch succeeds.

GovMarket (govmarket.com.au) surfaced Tasmania and Sydney Water opportunities but is a re-publishing aggregator; used only as a discovery signal and NOT recorded as a source of truth — the buyer's own portal is recorded instead.
recommended_seed_additions: NBN Co — Partners and Suppliers (SAP Ariba): https://www.nbnco.com.au/corporate-information/about-nbn-co/suppliers
University of Sydney — UniBuy / Suppliers (SAP Ariba Network): https://www.sydney.edu.au/about-us/working-with-the-university/suppliers.html

tenders.title: Ground Maintenance Services for CSIRO Managed Sites – VIC Metro
tenders.buyer: CSIRO (Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation)
tenders.description: CSIRO is seeking suitably qualified and experienced service providers to deliver grounds maintenance services at its Victorian metropolitan managed sites, including the Clayton Precinct (Clayton, Clayton North and Notting Hill), Aspendale, and Werribee (Sneydes Road and South Road).
tenders.deliverables_summary: Provision of grounds and landscape maintenance services across CSIRO's Victorian metropolitan sites, keeping grounds, gardens and external areas maintained to the required standard at the Clayton Precinct, Aspendale and Werribee locations. Delivery period indicated from around October 2026.
key_deliverables: Grounds maintenance at CSIRO Clayton Precinct (Clayton, Clayton North, Notting Hill)
Grounds maintenance at CSIRO Aspendale
Grounds maintenance at CSIRO Werribee (Sneydes Road and South Road)
tenders.scope_of_work: Grounds maintenance services across multiple CSIRO-managed Victorian metropolitan sites; commencement indicated around October 2026.
tenders.eligibility: Open approach to market (open to all suppliers).
tenders.delivery_location: CSIRO VIC metro sites: Clayton Precinct, Aspendale and Werribee, Victoria
tenders.detail_source: AusTender ATM CSIRORFT2026019 as indexed by web search / TenderTracker snippet (primary ATM page returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch)
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via search of CSIRO current AusTender RFTs; buyer-originated on AusTender. Closing date (17-Aug-2026) confirmed via a search-indexed tender-tracking snippet.
tenders.notes: Contract start (~Oct 2026) and site list from the listing description; full specification documents, evaluation criteria and contacts not readable this run (403). Contract-start date approximate.

tenders.title: Supply of Grid-fed Electricity to CSIRO Managed Sites in Western Australia
tenders.buyer: CSIRO (Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation)
tenders.description: CSIRO is seeking proposals for the supply of grid-fed electricity to its managed sites in Western Australia, including associated account management services (data provision, invoicing, site transfers) and the provision and administration of applicable environmental charges and green-energy options.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Retail supply of grid-fed electricity to CSIRO's Western Australian managed sites, together with account management services such as consumption data provision, invoicing and site transfers, plus administration of applicable environmental charges and optional green-energy products. Full scope captured at headline level only this run.
key_deliverables: Supply of grid-fed electricity to CSIRO WA managed sites
Account management services (data provision, invoicing, site transfers)
Provision/administration of environmental charges and green-energy options
tenders.eligibility: Open approach to market (open to all suppliers).
tenders.detail_source: AusTender ATM CSIRORFT2026004 as indexed by web search (primary ATM page returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch)
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via search of CSIRO current AusTender RFTs; buyer-originated on AusTender. Procurement-officer contact email quoted in the search-indexed listing.
tenders.notes: Headline-level only — closing date, contract term and documents not extractable this run (403); flagged in entries_pending_detail. Contact email is the tender-specific mailbox shown in the listing.

tenders.source_name: Tenders Tasmania / Department of State Growth
tenders.title: Northern Suburbs Community Recreation Hub – Stage 3 Expansion Construction Works
tenders.description: The Tasmanian Department of State Growth has released a Request for Tender for the main construction works of Stage 3 of Launceston's Northern Suburbs Community Recreation Hub at Mowbray – an approximately $18.9 million expansion of Tasmania's largest community sport and recreation facility.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Construction and fit-out of the Stage 3 expansion of the Northern Suburbs Community Recreation Hub at Mowbray, delivering approximately 5,000 square metres of additional indoor space including four additional indoor courts to support a broad range of sport and recreation activities.
key_deliverables: Main construction works for the Stage 3 expansion at Mowbray
Approximately 5,000 sqm of additional indoor space
Four additional indoor sport/recreation courts
Fit-out of the expanded facility
tenders.scope_of_work: Delivery of the Stage 3 main construction works for the Northern Suburbs Community Recreation Hub, Mowbray, expanding Tasmania's largest community sport and recreation facility by approximately 5,000 sqm and four indoor courts (project value approximately $18.9 million).
tenders.eligibility: Suitably qualified and experienced construction contractors.
tenders.detail_source: Multiple public sources (Australasian Leisure Management, Mirage News, GovMarket listing) reporting the Department of State Growth tender release; primary Tenders Tasmania notice returned 403 on direct fetch
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via search for recent Tasmanian RFTs (aggregator/media as discovery signal); buyer-originated by the Department of State Growth and published on Tenders Tasmania, which is recorded as the source of truth.
tenders.notes: Recently released (~22-Jul-2026). Closing date left null — a GovMarket snippet showed '17 Jul 2026' which is inconsistent with the 22-Jul release, so the date is unverified pending Tenders Tasmania. Value ($18.9M) and scope corroborated across multiple public reports.

tenders.title: Welding Aptitude Testing Program
tenders.description: The Australian Submarine Agency is seeking a suitably qualified supplier to design and deliver a Welding Aptitude Testing Program to help identify and develop future welders for the AUKUS submarine enterprise.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Design and delivery of a Welding Aptitude Testing Program that attracts applicants, facilitates hands-on welding construction and assessment activities, determines candidates' suitability for welding careers, and provides career-oriented conversations and participant follow-up. Program targets testing approximately 400 candidates over four years, aimed at individuals with limited to no prior welding experience.
key_deliverables: Attract and recruit program applicants
Facilitate hands-on welding construction and assessment activities
Assess and determine candidates' suitability for careers in welding
Conduct career-oriented conversations and participant follow-up
Test approximately 400 candidates over four years
tenders.scope_of_work: The ASA seeks to engage a supplier to run a testing program for individuals with limited to no welding experience, testing around 400 candidates over four years to determine aptitude and suitability for welding careers supporting the submarine workforce.
tenders.eligibility: Open approach to market (open to all suppliers).
tenders.contract_term: Program spans approximately four years (400 candidates over four years).
tenders.submission_method: Lodge electronically via AusTender using the Lodgement Page link on the ATM notice
tenders.detail_source: AusTender ATM RFT/WLD/2026 as indexed by web search (primary ATM page returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch)
tenders.reasoning: Previously tracked ATM (first seen 2026-07-30); still open and closing 3-Aug-2026. Re-confirmed current this run via search. Buyer-originated on AusTender.
tenders.notes: Known/active opportunity; closing imminent (3-Aug-2026). Publish date (2-Jul-2026) confirmed via search this run. Contacts and documents not readable (403).

tenders.title: ANSTO Intermediate Level Waste Capacity Increase (ILWCI+) Project – Industry Briefing / Upcoming RFT
tenders.buyer: Australian Nuclear Science and Technology Organisation (ANSTO)
tenders.description: ANSTO held an online industry briefing ahead of an upcoming open Request for Tender for the Intermediate Level Waste Capacity Increase (ILWCI+) Project at its Lucas Heights campus – construction of a new intermediate-level waste storage facility. The formal RFT is anticipated to be released via an open approach to market in early August 2026.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Upcoming works (RFT to follow) to construct a new Intermediate Level Waste storage facility within ANSTO's highly regulated operational environment, including significant reinforced concrete structures, specialist fabricated components, mechanical and electrical services, and integration of process systems requiring high standards of quality assurance, traceability, inspection and testing.
key_deliverables: Construction of a new Intermediate Level Waste storage facility (works to be scoped in the forthcoming RFT)
Significant reinforced concrete structures
Specialist fabricated components
Mechanical and electrical services
Integration of process systems with QA, traceability, inspection and testing
tenders.scope_of_work: Construction of a new Intermediate Level Waste storage facility at ANSTO's Lucas Heights campus within a highly regulated nuclear operational environment.
tenders.eligibility: Construction contractors interested in the upcoming RFT; industry briefing was open to interested organisations who registered.
tenders.briefing: Online industry briefing via Microsoft Teams held 31 July 2026 at 2:00 PM (registration was by email to jenksm@ansto.gov.au before 4:00 PM AEST on 29 July 2026). Formal open RFT anticipated early August 2026.
tenders.submission_method: Formal RFT to be released via AusTender open approach to market (watch AusTender in early August 2026)
tenders.detail_source: AusTender ATM PSC002897/Brief as indexed by web search (primary ATM page returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch)
tenders.reasoning: Previously tracked market-sounding notice (first seen 2026-07-30). Industry briefing has now occurred (31-Jul-2026); the open RFT is expected on AusTender in early August 2026. Buyer-originated on AusTender.
tenders.notes: Market-sounding / pre-RFT notice (not yet a live tender). Briefing date (31-Jul-2026) has now passed. Watch AusTender for the open ILWCI+ RFT in early August 2026.
